ad:
Senior Backend Engineer (Berlin, hybrid). Salary EUR 70,000–80,000 per year, no bonus.

Build and run the Go services behind our inventory sync, with data in PostgreSQL. You own features end to end and share on-call.

Essential: building backend services in Go; PostgreSQL schema design.
Preferred: retail or logistics experience.

Individual contributor role.
